items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: Maurice White, another brilliant producer with Earth, Wind & Fire — you know I learned some things with Maurice White that would — as I was saying before when we would do horn parts and he would sing a part.

ctx.x: You know you pretty much answered a question of mine because I’ve done some of this and I wondered, you seem to be indicating that what was on the cassette was pretty much a finished rhythm track and it had a vocal on it, whether it was just a scratch vocal or something to show you where the singing was.

Some of the Earth, Wind & Fire stuff the vocals were really sketchy so sometimes that’s why some of the Earth, Wind & Fire horn parts are busy and kind of stepping on the vocals because there were no vocals there in some cases. Like “I Am” that had just kind of a really rough sketchy vocal so you know the track, which was basically David Foster, you just write whatever you want to write and Maurice will deal with it, you know take some horns out there or, you know. So —
That’s interesting now if you hear that and you might say to yourself well I wouldn’t have written that there had I known.
